eligibility.quote: The Instant e-PAN service is available to all Individual taxpayers, who have not been allotted a Permanent Account Number (PAN) but possess Aadhaar and access to DigiLocker for fetching documents related to valid proof of Date of Birth upon obtaining the applicant’s consent.

eligibility.value: Any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker.
eligibility.quote: This Instant e-PAN service can be used by any individual who does not already have a PAN, has a valid Aadhaar linked to an active mobile number, and has access to DigiLocker.

eligibility.value: All Individual taxpayers, who have not been allotted a Permanent Account Number (PAN) but possess Aadhaar
eligibility.quote: The Instant e-PAN service is available to all Individual taxpayers, who have not been allotted a Permanent Account Number (PAN) but possess Aadhaar.

fact.quote: You only require a valid Aadhaar with updated KYC details, and a valid mobile number linked with your Aadhaar.

fees.quote: No. It is completely free of cost.

fees.value: The service is free of cost.
fees.quote: No. The service is free of cost.

issuing_authority.quote: Select the documents to be shared with Income Tax Department for proof of date of birth.

steps.value: Generate e-PAN with the help of Aadhaar and a mobile number registered with Aadhaar online without filling up any forms
steps.quote: If you have not been allotted a PAN, you can generate your e-PAN with the help of your Aadhaar and a mobile number registered with your Aadhaar. Generating e-PAN is free of cost, online process and does not require you to fill up any forms.

steps.value: Click Get New e-PAN on the e-PAN page
steps.quote: Step 2: On the ‘e-PAN’ page, click ‘Get New e-PAN’.

steps.value: Confirm all eligibility declaration checkboxes and consent checkbox, then click Continue
steps.quote: Step 3: On the Get New e-PAN page, confirm all four eligibility declaration checkboxes and also, checkbox for declaration for consent for the generation of a new PAN based on Digi Locker data and Aadhaar e-KYC details, after confirming all check boxes Continue button will enable. click ‘Continue’.

steps.value: Read the disclaimer and click Continue to access DigiLocker
steps.quote: Step 4: Read the disclaimer and click “Continue”. You will be redirected to access the Digi Locker platform for fetching Date of Birth details and supporting proof.

steps.value: Enter Aadhaar or VID number and captcha code, then click Next
steps.quote: Step 5: Enter the Aadhaar / VID number, captcha code and click Next.

steps.value: Enter the OTP sent to mobile number registered with Aadhaar and click continue
steps.quote: Step 6: Enter the OTP sent to the mobile number registered with Aadhaar and click continue.

steps.value: Enter 6-digit security PIN and click Continue
steps.quote: Step 7: Enter your 6-digit security PIN and click Continue.

steps.value: Select documents for proof of date of birth and click Allow
steps.quote: Step 8: Select the documents to be shared with Income Tax Department for proof of date of birth. Click Allow

steps.value: On Aadhaar validation page, enter Aadhaar Number for PAN allotment and click generate OTP
steps.quote: Step 9: On the Aadhaar validation page, enter the Aadhaar Number for PAN allotment and click generate OTP.

steps.value: Enter OTP received on Aadhaar registered mobile number and click continue
steps.quote: Step 10: Enter the OTP received on Aadhaar registered Mobile no. and click continue

steps.value: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click 'Instant e-PAN' under Quick Links, then click 'Get New e-PAN' on the e-PAN page.
steps.quote: On the e-Filing portal homepage, click ‘Instant e-PAN’ under Quick Links, then click ‘Get New e-PAN’ on the e-PAN page.

steps.value: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage, click Instant e-PAN.
steps.quote: Go to the e-Filing portal homepage, click Instant e-PAN.

steps.value: On the e-PAN page, click Get New e-PAN.
steps.quote: On the e-PAN page, click Get New e-PAN.

steps.value: Enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number, select the I confirm that checkbox and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the Get New e-PAN page, enter your 12-digit Aadhaar number, select the I confirm that checkbox and click Continue.

steps.value: On the OTP validation page, click I have read the consent terms and agree to proceed further and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the OTP validation page, click I have read the consent terms and agree to proceed further. Click Continue.

steps.value: Enter the 6-digit OTP received on the mobile number linked with Aadhaar, select the checkbox to validate the Aadhaar details with UIDAI and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the OTP validation page, enter the 6-digit OTP received on the mobile number linked with Aadhaar, select the checkbox to validate the Aadhaar details with UIDAI and click Continue.

steps.value: On the Validate Aadhaar Details page, select the I Accept that checkbox and click Continue.
steps.quote: On the Validate Aadhaar Details page, select the I Accept that checkbox and click Continue.
